text:
Alex: handing off overnight — ongoing incident in eu-west embeddings cluster, primary experiencing NVRAM pressure causing eviction storms. I'm the outgoing primary, leaving Morgan as active now; Priya will be prim on next rotation.

oncall-bot: INC created: INC-8245 — kv-cache eviction surge (eu-west-2). Pager to eng-oncall at 2026-03-15T22:33Z.

Morgan: quick status update — we saw p50->p99 token latency climb after 22:10Z, and a spike in 503s for embedding endpoints. Started mitigation at ~22:40Z: scaled prim/sec pool +1 replica, temporarily disabled prefetch on the affected route, and throttled top noisy API keys. Seeing error rate drop from ~12% -> ~4% for short sequences. Still seeing tail errors on long sequences (>1024).

Priya: runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction (follow the "prim/sec swap" section). Key ops runbook excerpts below: 

```
# commands we ran
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-daemon-eu-west-2
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/primsec-pool --replicas=6
# toggle prefetch flag
curl -X POST "https://admin-api/flags" -d '{"prefetch_enabled":false}'
```

Logs snippet showing eviction rate: 

```
[2026-03-15T22:37:12Z] kv_eviction: rate=0.84, mem_pressure=0.91, evict_ops=423
[2026-03-15T22:39:58Z] request: embed /v1/embeddings 503 user=embedly-corp seq_len=2300
```

Tasha: customer impact: Embedly Corp and Helpdesk AI saw increased errors on long sequences; SLO alerting hit for Helpdesk AI (>=5% error over 5m). We opened support tickets and notified CS. No broad customer-facing outage, partial failures for heavy/long requests only.

Morgan: current mitigations in progress: 
- rolling restart of kv-daemon across eu-west shard (in progress, batch 2/4)
- temporary rate-limit policy applied to top 5 noisy keys (policy id: rl-2026-03-15-eu2)
- prim/sec autoscale paused until stability verified

Priya: next checks for incoming shift: verify health endpoints and queue depth, run the following queries: 

```
# quick health checks
curl -s https://metrics-api/health | jq .kv_cache
curl -s https://metrics-api/queues | jq '.embeddings | {depth,p99}'
```
If p99 > 1s or queue depth > 200, escalate to sec-eng and consider rolling back recent kernel/driver patch (linked in runbook).

Tasha: handoff assignments for next 4 hours: 
- Primary (on-call responsibility): Priya (starts 23:05Z)
- Secondary: Tasha (covers escalation)
- Observability lead: Morgan (still running live mitigations)

Coverage gap note: there's a scheduled brief maintenance window 02:00-02:30Z that overlaps with Priya's shift; we do not have another prim/sec on-call available for those 30m. Plan: keep autoscaling off and keep rate limits conservative during window. If we see >3% errors during that window, escalate to EngSRE paging rotation.

incident-bot: INC-8245 update: noise reduced after throttling and restart batch 2/4; next check in 20m.

Alex: handing over — I've synced with Priya and Morgan on the checklist. Key things for next shift: keep an eye on evict_ops, ensure prefetch stays disabled until we confirm stable p99, and confirm CS follow-up with Embedly. Escalation path: Pager -> on-call -> EngSRE manager (if customer-impacting > 30m).

Priya: acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and the restart batches. If anything spikes, I'll call the bridge.

Morgan: noted — I'll post a short summary when batch 4 completes. :thumbsup:

Tasha: thanks — leaving this thread pinned for the bridge handover. If anyone picks up pages overnight, ping me directly (@Tasha).

Alex: closing handoff — please update this thread with any changes.
